item.title: Opera One becomes the best browser for video streaming: adds YouTube and Twitch to Sidebar
item.content:encoded: Opera One is integrating YouTube and Twitch to the sidebar, introducing a native Volume Booster feature, and a revamped Video Popout feature.

item.title: Stop copy-pasting: Opera’s new Browser Connector brings Claude & ChatGPT into the browser
item.content:encoded: Opera is shipping the new Browser Connector which lets you plug your Claude AI or ChatGPT into the browser via the MCP standard.

item.title: Opera Neon now supports MCP Connector that let you control the browser through other AI clients
item.content:encoded: Opera Neon enables MCP Connector enabling external AI clients to connect directly to the browser, access live web context and act inside it.
